raw_meta_yaml:
{% set version = "0.2.7" %}

package:
  name: julius
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/j/julius/julius-{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 3c0f5f5306d7d6016fcc95196b274cae6f07e2c9596eed314e4e7641554fbb08

build:
  noarch: python
  script: {{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
  number: 0

requirements:
  host:
    - python {{ python_min }}
    - pip
    - setuptools
  run:
    - python >={{ python_min }}
    - pytorch >=1.7.0

test:
  imports:
    - julius
  commands:
    - pip check
  requires:
    - pip
    - python {{ python_min }}

about:
  home: https://github.com/adefossez/julius
  summary: 'Nice DSP sweets: resampling, FFT Convolutions. All with PyTorch, differentiable and with CUDA support.'
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - fitzgeralddp
